free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: head width of the 4-D control tensor; used only after the target assert (streaming_forward uses it to pad/reshape)

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed torch seed so both inputs and repeats are deterministic

free_parameters.name: batch
free_parameters.why: batch size; only multiplies leading tensor dimensions and cannot change q.dim()

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: head count; only multiplies leading tensor dimensions and cannot change q.dim()

free_parameters.name: n_init
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs n_init passed at the call site; only used after the target assert

free_parameters.name: n_local
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs n_local large enough that k_len <= n_local, a single streaming stage after the target

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: entry argument head_id, read only after the streaming branch returns
